segments.name: investment in hotel properties
segments.description: Owns and leases luxury and upper upscale hotels and resorts, earning rooms, food and beverage and other revenue from guests.
segments.evidence: We combine each operating segment into one reportable segment: investment in hotel properties.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay for rooms, food and beverage and other hotel services; the taxable REIT subsidiary leases the hotels and third-party operators manage them.
revenueModel.evidence: which engages third-party eligible independent contractors to manage the hotels.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company sold the Fairmont Dallas hotel in Dallas, Texas.
changes.evidence: The sale closed in April 2025 resulting in a gain of $ 40.0 million.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company sold the Lorien Hotel & Spa in Alexandria, Virginia.
changes.evidence: The sale closed in July 2024 resulting in a gain of $ 1.6 million.
